pacing_notes: The entire ~11.6s reel is a single unbroken static shot (one scene boundary, zero cuts) of the two stop-motion characters sitting on the seesaw. There is no editing-driven pacing at all; instead pacing is carried entirely by the word-by-word caption reveal ('LEAST', 'LET', etc.) timed to the dialogue/voiceover, which builds the sentence at a steady clip up to the punchline, then holds on the same static frame for the title card ('LOW BATTERY PEOPLE - CREATED BY NIN.') as the CTA/outro beat. No coverage changes, no reaction cutaways, and no camera movement across the whole runtime.
